strings.zh: 俺们觉醒了！{SCROLL}你问觉醒了什么？{SCROLL}俺们知道精灵{NEWLINE}在记住觉醒力量时,{SCROLL}会学会哪种{NEWLINE}类型的技能咯！厉害吧。{SCROLL}怎么样？让俺们看看{NEWLINE}你的精灵能记住{CLEAR}哪种类型的觉醒力量吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I woke up and realized my potential!{SCROLL}So, what potential was woken in me?{NEWLINE}What’s my hidden power, you ask?{SCROLL}It’s a power that lets me see the{NEWLINE}Hidden Power of a Pokémon.{SCROLL}When they learn that move, I can tell{NEWLINE}what type the move will be.{SCROLL}So, want me to use my hidden power?{SCROLL}I’ll tell you what type your{NEWLINE}Pokémon’s Hidden Power will be. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你的精灵记住了哪种类型的觉醒力量{CLEAR}让俺们看看吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I’ll tell you what type your Pokémon’s{NEWLINE}Hidden Power will be.{SCROLL}My own hidden power lets me{NEWLINE}do that. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这只精灵能记住的觉醒力量{CLEAR}类型是「{VAR:010F:0}」！

strings.zh: 这只精灵会使用的觉醒力量是「{VAR:010F:0}」！

strings.zh: 如果你想了解的话,{NEWLINE}就问觉醒了的俺们吧！

strings.zh: 嗯！这只精灵记不住觉醒力量！
strings.en: Oh, no. This Pokémon can’t learn the{NEWLINE}move Hidden Power in the first place.
